**Huntington Bancshares (HBAN) 3Q26: NIM Expands, but Soft Fees and Higher NCOs Trim Adjusted EPS**

**Headline & EPS Drivers:** Focusing on **adjusted** diluted EPS, HBAN reported $0.38 in 3Q26, missing 2Q26 ($0.39) by $0.01 (-3% QoQ) [B0010, B0065, B0069]. Reported GAAP EPS was flat sequentially at $0.33 [B0031]. 3Q26 notable items reduced EPS by $(0.05) ($98 million after-tax), consisting of $117 million pre-tax in Cadence/Veritex acquisition-related expenses ($(0.05)) and an $8 million pre-tax acquired equity security conversion adjustment ($0.00/share), compared with $(0.06) in 2Q26 [B0063, B0064, B0068]. Stripping out notable items, higher NII (+$17 million GAAP) and a $9 million lower credit provision were outweighed by a $55 million drop in adjusted noninterest income and a higher effective tax rate (19.3% vs. 18.4% on non-deductible expenses) [B0022, B0170, B0251, B0286].

**Revenue & Margin:** GAAP NII rose $17 million (+1% QoQ) to $2,069 million ($2,090 million FTE) [B0022, B0023]. FTE NIM expanded 4 bps QoQ to 3.25% as securities yields jumped 12 bps to 3.59% and average borrowings declined $3.6 billion, more than offsetting a 2 bps rise in total deposit costs to 1.90% [B0037, B0097, B0100, B0105]. Average loans slipped 0.4% QoQ to $188.4 billion (C&I +$0.6 billion, CRE -$0.9 billion, consumer -$0.5 billion), while average deposits rose 0.2% to $223.8 billion [B0015, B0016, B0047, B0048, B0117-B0126]. Reported noninterest income fell 8% QoQ to $722 million ($730 million adjusted, -7% QoQ) on weaker capital markets (-$18 million), mortgage (-$8 million), and unfavorable strategic investment valuations in other income (-$35 million reported) [B0162-B0170, B0177]. Reported expenses fell $37 million to $1,772 million on lower acquisition charges [B0197, B0212]; adjusted expenses were essentially flat (-$2 million to $1,655 million), keeping the reported efficiency ratio at 61.2% (-30 bps QoQ) [B0225, B0038].

**Credit:** Credit metrics softened modestly. NCOs rose $27 million QoQ to $146 million, or 0.31% of average loans (+6 bps QoQ), while NPAs climbed $110 million to $1,722 million (0.90% vs. 0.85%) [B0245, B0249, B0252, B0253]. Despite higher NCOs, provision fell $9 million to $123 million and the ACL ratio dipped 3 bps to 1.75% [B0251, B0262].

**Capital & Returns:** Reported ROTCE was 14.6% (-50 bps QoQ) and adjusted ROTCE was 16.6% (-90 bps QoQ) [B0035, B0036]. CET1 rose 10 bps to 10.1% (adjusted CET1 8.9%, -10 bps), while TBVPS fell 2% QoQ to $9.47 on AOCI headwinds [B0032, B0040, B0041, B0018]. HBAN repurchased $100 million of common stock [B0019].

**Guidance & Thesis:** No quantitative guidance was provided in the release, though management reiterated confidence in achieving Cadence/Veritex synergies and financial targets [B0050]. A slightly softer fee and credit quarter does not alter the core thesis, but rising NPAs and NCOs warrant monitoring.
